rationale: C22 is an exceptionally close and immediately preceding template: it uses the same three-recital sequence, the same finding-and-report provision, the same Defense Production Act compliance clause, and the same Railway Labor Act status-quo clause in precisely the same order. The child principally substitutes Northwest Airlines and its union for Pan American and its union. C21 is also highly relevant because it concerns the identical carrier and union, but it lacks the Defense Production Act clause found in the child and C22. C03 contains all the same operative machinery, though its final two provisions appear in reverse order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Northwest Airlines, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Association of Machinists, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pan American World Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, CIO, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital follows the same carrier–employees–labor-organization formula, with only the disputing parties changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order. In performing its functions under this order the board shall comply with the requirements of section 502 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order. In performing its functions under this order the board shall comply with the requirements of section 502 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.
shared_material.explanation: These consecutive operative provisions are effectively verbatim and constitute distinctive shared administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement shall be made by the Northwest Airlines, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement shall be made by the Pan American World Airways, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The status-quo provision is copied nearly verbatim, with only the carrier name replaced.
